integrity: The proof derives the expected range exactly as a linear functional of support locations, applies weighted Cauchy--Schwarz, proves the equality support is ordered from strict convexity, and identifies the precise loss from the unrestricted sharp constant by an orthogonal cell-average decomposition. Exact-rational computation replays all algebraic identities but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes a finite positive atom-probability profile and varies only ordered support locations.
The new claim is stated for sample size n at least three; n equal to two is the classical Gini mean-difference case.
The full 1947 Plackett text was not available without publisher-side human verification, so it remains an explicit access-related originality risk.
title: Fixed atom profiles sharpen the expected-range/standard-deviation bound
